Kălendālis or Kălendāris , e, adj. Kalendae,
I.of or belonging to the Kalends; of or belonging to the first day of the month: “tributa Kalendalia,” which fall due on the Kalends, Just. Edict. 13 : “Juno Kalendaris,” to whom worship is paid on the Kalends, Macr. S. 1, 15, 18 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
